emails: Brenden Meek, Branch Manager - Relief (email, undated screenshot, 15 Oct 2026): 5x boards VMS13-17 will need to go out early. As track will be closed and they show everyone how to get out of the track.

Steve Haines, Safety and Traffic Coordinator, iEDM, email 'VMS gate 6' to Brenden Meek (screenshot 15 Oct 2026): Minor change to VMS 20, alter the location slightly and change orientation and message at midday; each morning Message 1 9am till 12pm, then from 12pm Message 2; spreadsheet and map updated.

Brenden Meek, email 'VMS', 7 Oct 2026 09:29: VMS 9 & 10 go out tomorrow. VMS 9 uses the board Andrew took from pit lane (turn on so it can be programmed). VMS 10 came down with the accessible toilet, a rehire unit from Premiair.
source.positions: Positions are placed from the plan's own map crops against landmarks the page already holds to the metre (the master plan's gates, turn markers, WC16, P60, the pit lane line) or the named intersections (TomTom cross-street geocode, 15 Oct 2026), each within the metres stated on its line. D025's callout bubbles were checked on the 2022 aerial and sit tens of metres off the spots (several in the river), so they are not used. A pin taken on site or a lat/lon typed on the board's line overrides the plan position.
